title: LIST: Winners, 2026 Palanca Awards
summary: Playwright Dustin Celestino is inducted into the Palanca Hall of Fame

blocks.text: Playwright Dustin Celestino is inducted into the Palanca Hall of Fame

items: The 76th Carlos Palanca Memorial Awards for Literature honored 63 winning pieces by 60 writers across 22 categories on November 24, 2026.
Dustin Celestino was inducted into the Palanca Hall of Fame after winning his fifth First Prize for his piece 'Kritisismo.'
The awards featured various divisions including Kabataan, Filipino, Regional Languages, and English, recognizing outstanding works in categories such as short stories, essays, poetry, and plays.

blocks.text: This is AI-generated. Read the article for full context. Report any errors.
MANILA, Philippines – The 76th Carlos Palanca Memorial Awards for Literature recognized a new set of honorees across 22 categories on Tuesday, November 24.

The prestigious awards ceremony, which has been conferring literary prizes on stellar Filipino writers since 1951, received over 3,000 entries for this year’s edition, eventually narrowing it down to 63 winning pieces by 60 writers.

Dustin Celestino, meanwhile, was inducted into the Palanca Hall of Fame after receiving his fifth First Prize, which he achieved through his piece “Kritisismo” under the Dulang Ganap angHaba category. The playwright is now the 31st Hall of Fame winner.
